stages.name: Celebrity Effect
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Dormitory, restores <@cc.vup>+0.15</> Morale per hour to all Operators assigned to that Dormitory (Only the strongest effect of this type takes place)

stages.name: Invite to the Show
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the HR Office, HR contacting speed <@cc.vup>+45%</>

stages.name: Fleeting Foam
stages.description: Every Attack Interval, an allied unit within range gains a bubble granting 10% <$ba.protect>Sanctuary</>; bubbles will pop shortly after being damaged by an enemy

stages.name: Fleeting Foam
stages.description: Every Attack Interval, an allied unit within range gains a bubble granting 20% <$ba.protect>Sanctuary</>; bubbles will pop shortly after being damaged by an enemy

stages.name: Fleeting Foam

stages.name: Soaring Fireworks
stages.description: Whenever a bubble pops, the unit at its former location is healed for 25% of Haruka's ATK

stages.name: Soaring Fireworks
stages.description: Whenever a bubble pops, the unit at its former location is healed for 28% <@ba.talpu>(+3%)</> of Haruka's ATK
